messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Synthetic canary 'text-gen-canary-eu' failing in eu-west-1 — 12 failures / 60 probes. PagerDuty INC-2026-045 triggered.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-045 — Synthetic canary failures (eu-west-1). Severity: P2. Assigned to lina.

lina: acked in PD, looking now.

lina: quick check — canary dashboard looks like a sudden spike of 502s around 02:11 UTC. Opening probe logs.

caroline: on my way, opening the prober logs and infra dashboards. link: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/text-gen-eu 

lina: tail of prober logs:
```
2026-03-09T02:10:59Z canary-prober text-gen-eu probe_id=937 status=200 latency=112ms
2026-03-09T02:11:14Z canary-prober text-gen-eu probe_id=938 status=502 backend=inference-router-1
2026-03-09T02:11:20Z canary-prober text-gen-eu probe_id=939 status=502 err="tls: handshake failure"
2026-03-09T02:11:35Z canary-prober text-gen-eu probe_id=940 status=502 backend=inference-router-1
```

caroline: `kubectl get pods -n canary` shows two prober pods in CrashLoopBackOff and 3 nodes in eu-west-1 reporting kubelet oomkill in last 15m. Suspect autoscaler jitter + kubelet OOMs.

infra-bot: Note: autoscaler last config change by infra-team at 2026-03-09T01:55:00Z (scaleDownAggression=high).

lina: mitigation plan (short):
  1) Pause synthetic checks for eu-west-1 to stop noisy pages.
  2) Reroute canary traffic to eu-fallback pool so probes don't hit the impacted router.
  3) Ask infra to revert recent autoscaler aggression change and check kubelet memory leak.
  4) Monitor real customer traffic for user-facing 5xx.

caroline: executing step 2 now — running: `infractl router set --canary text-gen-eu --pool eu-fallback`

caroline: done, router reports canary now routed to eu-fallback nodes.

incident-bot: Action logged: synthetic checks paused by lina (reason: noisy failures) :white_check_mark:.

pagerduty: INC-2026-045 acknowledged by lina at 02:18 UTC.

support: support queue: two customers filed chats at ~02:13 UTC complaining of transient errors to /v1/generate but both later succeeded. No widespread escalations yet. Flagged for follow-up.

lina: looking at production metrics — overall 5xx rate for hosted text-gen is +0.02% in eu-west-1 spike window, not sustained. Latency unaffected for most customers. No SLA breaches detected so far.

david: I pulled a sample of error traces — most are coming from inference-router-1 returning 502 when backend timed out; correlated with the prober failures.

caroline: infra confirms autoscaler config reverted and kubelet oom patch is rolling to eu-west-1 nodes (hotfix image v1.2.3). Will take ~12-20 minutes for rollout.

lina: plan update: keep canaries paused until rollout completes and we observe 10 consecutive successful probes on eu-fallback, then slowly re-enable.

caroline: started a short-term pod bump on prober fleet to 3 replicas to speed recovery, and increased node memory threshold. Command used: `kubectl scale deploy/canary -n canary --replicas=3`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-045 status changed to "investigating" -> "mitigated" (temporary measures applied).

lina: customer impact summary for this incident:
- Scope: synthetic canaries failing in eu-west-1, small number of user-facing transient errors (2 chats).
- Severity: potential P2 if sustained, but currently limited and mitigated.
- Action taken: paused synthetic checks, rerouted canary to fallback pool, infra hotfix rolled.

david: support will keep watch for any re-opens or escalations, tagging any new reports to INC-2026-045.

lina: shift handoff: my oncall window ends at 02:45 UTC, handing off to caroline for steady-state watch and verification. Caroline, please take ownership and close PD once stable.

caroline: ack — I'll monitor the next 30m and watch for probe success count. If we see 10/10 green on eu-fallback and no customer errors, I'll resolve INC-2026-045.

infra-bot: Hotfix rollout progress: eu-west-1: 40% -> 70% -> 100% applied (kubelet memory fix).

caroline: seeing prober health come back. Re-enabled a small percentage (10%) of synthetic checks to validate. First 20 probes all successful.

lina: thanks team. Please add any follow-ups to the incident doc (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-045) — especially action item for autoscaler tuning.

caroline: closing notes: revert aggressive scaleDown flag to safe defaults in staging + run 24h soak. I'll close the PD if no regressions. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: INC-2026-045 resolved by caroline at 02:42 UTC — Reason: autoscaler reverted and canary rerouted; canaries stable on fallback, customers unaffected after mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident log appended, follow-ups: autoscaler tuning, prober memory profiling, update runbook with reroute playbook. Participants: lina, caroline, david, infra.

caroline: closing thread.
